# Approvals API endpoints
{: .no_toc}

Shared catalogs and taxonomies are changed through approval requests: a submission creates a request that the admin team of that domain accepts, merges, sends back or rejects. These resources list and manage the requests; the accepted entries appear in the catalog resource itself.

| Resource | App | What it is |
|:---------|:----|:-----------|
| [`consumableapproval`](/api/resources/consumableapproval/) | Resources | A request to add or change a shared consumable, reviewed before it takes effect |
| [`hardwaredeviceapproval`](/api/resources/hardwaredeviceapproval/) | Resources | A request to add or change a shared hardware device, reviewed before it takes effect |
| [`supplierapproval`](/api/resources/supplierapproval/) | Resources | A request to add or change a shared supplier, reviewed before it takes effect |
| [`behavioralcategoryapproval`](/api/taxonomies/behavioralcategoryapproval/) | Taxonomies | A request to add or change a shared behavioral category, reviewed before it takes effect |
| [`behavioralparadigmapproval`](/api/taxonomies/behavioralparadigmapproval/) | Taxonomies | A request to add or change a shared behavioral paradigm, reviewed before it takes effect |
| [`regulatoryauthorityapproval`](/api/taxonomies/regulatoryauthorityapproval/) | Taxonomies | A request to add or change a shared regulatory authority, reviewed before it takes effect |
| [`setuptypeapproval`](/api/taxonomies/setuptypeapproval/) | Taxonomies | A request to add or change a shared setup type, reviewed before it takes effect |
| [`speciesapproval`](/api/taxonomies/speciesapproval/) | Taxonomies | A request to add or change a shared species, reviewed before it takes effect |
| [`strainapproval`](/api/taxonomies/strainapproval/) | Taxonomies | A request to add or change a shared strain, reviewed before it takes effect |
| [`journalapproval`](/api/dissemination/journalapproval/) | Dissemination | A request to add or change a shared journal, reviewed before it takes effect |
| [`publicationapproval`](/api/dissemination/publicationapproval/) | Dissemination | A request to add or change a shared publication, reviewed before it takes effect |
